units.source_text: 薰中纳言派使者把这些衣物送交二女公子身边的侍女大辅君。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, sent a messenger to deliver these garments to Lady Taifu, an attendant serving the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 这侍女年龄较长，是二女公子所亲信的。

en.t: This attendant was somewhat older and was trusted by the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 使者口头传言：“奉上之衣物，系匆匆置办，毫不足观，尚请善为处置。”

en.t: The messenger conveyed the message orally: These garments are offered in haste and are hardly worth notice, but please dispose of them as you think best.

units.source_text: 赠二女公子的衣料，力求不要显目，装进盒子，但包装特别讲究。

en.t: The fabric meant for the Second Princess was placed in a box so as not to attract attention, but the wrapping was especially elegant.

units.source_text: 大辅君并不拿去给二女公子看。

en.t: Lady Taifu did not take it to show the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 只因薰中纳言此种馈赠，乃以前常有之事，大家早已见惯，不须谦让答谢、你推我辞，

en.t: Since gifts of this kind from Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, had long been common, everyone was already used to them, and there was no need for formal thanks, refusals, or polite back-and-forth.

units.source_text: 所以大辅君绝不觉得难于处置，就把衣料分送诸人，众侍女各自拿去缝衣服了。

en.t: So Lady Taifu did not find them difficult to handle at all; she divided the fabric among the others, and the attendants each took some away to sew into clothing.

units.source_text: 贴身服侍的青年侍女，服饰原应该特别讲究。

en.t: Young attendants who served close at hand were naturally expected to be especially careful about their dress.

units.source_text: 那些下级侍女呢，平时惯穿粗布衣服的，

en.t: As for the lower-ranking attendants, who were usually accustomed to wearing coarse cloth,

units.source_text: 如今穿了薰中纳言所赐的白色夹衫，虽然不甚惹目，倒也显得清爽。

en.t: now that they wore the white lined robes bestowed by Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, they did not look especially striking, but they did appear neat and fresh.
